results.rationale: Consistency: charger arrangement and pale setting persist, but large-charger outline and printed port labels change. Instruction: the right charger remains visibly smaller, with no meaningful size match. Quality: recognizable solid products and natural shadows, but several left-port labels are malformed.

Consistency: original regular three-by-three picture grid, icon positions and borders are replaced by an irregular layout. Instruction: the edit adds arbitrary numerals and distorted symbols rather than appropriately completing the supplied grid; it also is not a completed nine-by-nine Sudoku. Knowledge: duplicated and nonnumeric entries with inconsistent cells do not satisfy Sudoku logic; instruction failure ⇒ knowledge invalid. Quality: malformed icons, overlapping glyphs and irregular cell divisions are severe structural and semantic errors.
